fusions.name: Leave a Red Trail
fusions.desc: Throws a crescent that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winded Prey
fusions.desc: A cut on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Quarry in Outline
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of the Wound
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 20% more damage.
